body.x: Panasonic(www.panasonic.net) announced New Multi-Room Hi-Fi Speaker System 'Allplay™' at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Using an iOS or Android smartphone or tablet, music can be wirelessly transmitted throughout the house with a music subscription service or Internet radio. "Party mode" provides even more fun by allowing the same songs to be simultaneously played to several connected speakers.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
